root_cause.reason: The QA deployment is missing the effective Upstash Redis runtime configuration; its fail-closed internal readiness rate-limit prevents the protected readiness and release-provenance paths from executing.
root_cause.do_not_infer: This 503 does not establish Stripe or Supabase downtime and does not prove a specific missing variable individually; one or both effective values may be missing.
root_cause.security_policy: Keep fail-closed; do not bypass rate-limit, use production Redis credentials, or create unapproved paid infrastructure.

restoration_attempt.no_costs: No Redis instance created, no billable plan enabled, no production variables copied
restoration_attempt.security_boundary: A Vercel preview or production credential cannot be assumed QA-isolated without provider-side account+role+environment evidence.
restoration_attempt.safe_next_step: Provision two encrypted custom QA environment variables only after an existing separately isolated Redis instance and token are confirmed; add QA-only HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN separately and redeploy only QA after approval-free scoped configuration. Do not print or commit values.
restoration_attempt.validation_boundary: Even after Redis, QA requires a healthcheck bearer token for /api/ready; other provider readiness may be intentionally unavailable by QA_BOOTSTRAP_NO_BILLING. Therefore do not demand 200 when services are disabled by design.

rollback_target_readiness.candidate_history_source: Vercel get_deployment and GET /api/health on two immutable preview deployments
rollback_target_readiness.note: These previews are NOT approved known-good rollback targets; public health does not prove customer workflows or provider separation.

remediation_and_retest.operator_action: Using an existing authorized, isolated QA Upstash instance, provision or restore both variables via the Vercel QA/Preview environment without printing or persisting values; verify actual deployment environment inheritance; redeploy only QA, no production deployment.
verification_sequence: Read Vercel QA runtime logs and verify no Redis not configured/error entries for new GET readiness requests.
GET QA /api/ready/release without bearer -> expected 401 (or fail-closed 503 if backend still unavailable); 401 alone proves only token protection, not release provenance.
Use authorized QA-only HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN to GET /api/ready/release, check expected exact QA deployment SHA and sanitized provenance.
With separately authorized QA-only token, GET /api/ready must exercise readiness dependencies. Require expected result based on configured QA services, not force a 200.
Execute isolated monitoring smoke only after validating QA-only Sentry/alert routing; verify alert received and redacted, record escalation owner and acknowledgement; test incident drill.
Do not mark OPS-03, OPS-04, A-20 or any Production GO as PASS without exact-SHA release-bound and independent review evidence.

caveats: Dashboard HTTP 200 does not prove authenticated use or tenant isolation.
Public GET is not signup/login/form-submission/Stripe E2E.
No canonical candidate exact-SHA deployment smoke or GO acceptance.
